_about: options.json: WORDING, CONTROL TYPE AND DEFAULTS ONLY. It is never the validator: every value from a menu, the desktop app or a connected AI passes the same server-side schema check before anything renders. Field paths are the engine's profile schema. status: built = the engine accepts it; planned = named, not built; reserved = stored, not applied yet. Owner of fields: ENGINE; owner of wording: WEB. assets/options-data.js is GENERATED from this file by tools/make-options-data.mjs.

groups.label: Size and speed
groups.help: How big the film is and how it moves.

groups.label: Words on screen
groups.help: The question and key a viewer reads first.

groups.label: Coming later
groups.help: Shown greyed out, with who is building it.

options.label: Page
options.help: Dark or light page behind the film. Dark is the default.

options.label: Page colour
options.help: Leave blank to use the page's own colour.

options.label: Quiet text colour
options.help: Source lines and small print.

options.label: Map colour for low values
options.help: The colour of the lowest numbers.
options.note: ENGINE's dark-ramp rule refuses a low colour too close to the page; the page shows the engine's own sentence

options.label: Map colour for high values
options.help: The colour of the highest numbers.

options.label: Map fill
options.help: Solid or hatched fill.

options.label: Smooth colours
options.help: Colours blend smoothly instead of in bands.

options.label: Number of colour bands
options.help: How many colour bands the map uses. Auto lets the engine choose.

options.label: Hatch line colour
options.help: Only used when the map fill is hatched.

options.label: Dot colour
options.help: Places drawn as dots.

options.label: Dot colour at the start
options.help: Where a dot starts from.

options.label: Dot size
options.help: Bigger dots are easier to see on a phone.

options.label: Place fill
options.help: The fill of places with data.

options.label: No-data colour
options.help: Places with no number for the year.

options.label: Outline thickness
options.help: The line around each place. 0 hides it.

options.label: How fast bars swap places
options.help: Seconds a bar takes to move when its rank changes.

options.label: Space for names
options.help: Width of the name column, in pixels. Advanced.

options.label: Space for numbers
options.help: Width of the number column, in pixels. Advanced.

options.label: Size
options.help: Widescreen for YouTube; vertical for Shorts.

choices.label: Vertical for Shorts (1080 x 1920)
choices.note: the schema accepts it but a true vertical layout is not built yet (ENGINE profile note); BUILDER's vertical work; show greyed with 'not ready yet'

options.label: Smoothness
options.help: Frames per second. 30 is smooth; 24 looks more like cinema.

options.label: Pause at the end
options.help: How long the last picture stays on screen.

soft.text: A pause over 2 seconds can feel long. You can keep it.

options.label: Between scenes
options.help: How one scene gives way to the next.

options.label: Scene change length
options.help: Seconds the change takes.

options.label: Title fade
options.help: Seconds the title card fades in.

options.label: Title position
options.help: Centre or left.

options.label: Question under the title
options.help: The one question this film answers, up to 120 characters. It stays on screen.

options.label: A line of detail
options.help: Optional, under the question.

options.label: How fast the data fades in
options.help: 0 turns the fade off.

options.label: The colour key
options.help: 2 to 8 marks along the colour bar, each with a plain label.
options.note: stops are increasing and each inside the colour ramp's own range; the page shows the engine's sentence when refused

options.label: Music
options.help: A track under the film. Needs the audio block merged and a licence answer for uploads.

options.label: Captions
options.help: Burned-in captions and a .srt file.

options.label: Glow on map edges
options.help: A soft glow on the outer edge of each landmass, never per county (Ryan 10-20). Setting name: UNKNOWN to WEB.

options.label: Use each year's borders
options.help: Switch a map to the borders of each year, for example Connecticut's counties then planning regions.

options.label: Fonts
options.help: Stored, not applied yet.

options.label: Channel name and credit line
options.help: Stored, not applied yet.
